entities.summary: Qakare Ibi was an ancient Egyptian king during the early First Intermediate Period and the 14th ruler of the Eighth Dynasty. As such, Ibi's seat of power was Memphis and he probably did not hold power over all of Egypt. Ibi is one of the best attested kings of the Eighth Dynasty due to the discovery of his small pyramid in South Saqqara.
